description: This file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends a base FilterParams class and is used to handle filtering parameters specific to employee work experience searches, including sorting by job title or employer, and filtering by employee number.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that encapsulates filtering parameters for employee work experience searches, such as sorting options and employee identification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field of 'we.jobTitle'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Getter method for retrieving the employee number filter as an integer or null.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Setter method for assigning an employee number filter, accepting an integer or null.
